description: All six container signatures support concrete types, cached instances, receiver parameters, and non-Copy elements.
Box new checks its value against the concrete element type.
An explicit Vec push checks the element argument type.
An explicit Vec remove requires a usize index.
An explicit Vec push cannot coerce a shared receiver to a mutable reference.
Unknown container associated items are rejected.
Vec operations are not registered on Box.
Associated item type arguments are rejected even when the base signature is cached.
Container qualifiers accept exactly one concrete type argument.
An invalid element type propagates Error instead of creating a builtin signature.
An explicit mutable receiver argument must preserve an outer Vec indexing restriction.
